title.narrative: Reducing harm to civilians in Ukraine through community-based protection and civil-military engagement

description.narrative: Contract related to: Reducing harm to civilians in Ukraine through community-based protection and civil-military engagement - This 18-month measure will continue to provide urgent support to the protection of civilians and the safeguarding of cultural heritage in Ukraine. A first component will provide further support to the protection of civilians by engaging with voluntary groups within the Ukrainian Armed Forces regarding their obligations under International Humanitarian Law. Support will be provided to efforts that help the Ukrainian Armed Forces to identify appropriate responses to community protection needs and design approaches to civil-military interactions. A second component will provide continued support to the safeguarding of Ukrainian cultural heritage against the Russian war of aggression, by supporting the stabilisation of cultural heritage sites, ahead of future full restoration, and by continuing to support the protection and potential evacuation of collections and items.
